keys.range: Choose every file up to this one
keys.open: Open the file in the viewer

missing.warn: Missing before {status}: {document}. The move is still allowed.
missing.block: Missing before {status}: {document}. The move is refused until it is here.

forbidden.title: You cannot see this record's files
forbidden.body: Your role does not let you read the files of this record. Ask an administrator if you need them.

empty.title: No files yet
empty.bodyUpload: Drop files above, or browse: you choose their kind and who sees them.
empty.body: Files added to this record show here.

upload.hint: Drop files here or browse. You choose their kind and who sees them; they start office only.
upload.noRight: You cannot add files here: your role does not allow uploads.

audience.OFFICEBody: Only colleagues who may read this record.
audience.FLOORBody: Also the tablets on the floor of this record's site.
audience.PARTNERBody: {party} sees it in its portal. Only this record's customer or supplier.
audience.LINKBody: Also people this record was shared with by a link.

upload.sheetHint: a PDF or a photo; body data: only those with the measurements right open it, each opening recorded
upload.sheetFloor: A measurement sheet never goes to the floor: choose another audience or untick it
upload.sheetType: a measurement sheet is a PDF or a photo of one
upload.noFiscal: No “Fiscal copy” here: a fiscal paper is made at its home.
upload.noneYet: Drop or browse the files to add first.
upload.heldTitle_one: {count} file is held for the virus scan
upload.heldTitle_other: {count} files are held for the virus scan

refused.forbidden: Your role cannot add files here.
refused.notFound: This record is not found any more.

upload.subtitle: {record} · Files
upload.hintOrder: Up to 25 MB a document, 15 MB a photo. Each file is checked for viruses first.
upload.happens: The files are checked for viruses first: until then yours show as held, and others see them counted. They show where they go: Order & thread, or Lines & artwork.
upload.customer: The customer sees nothing until a file is shared with it.
upload.never: Each file keeps who added it and when. A file never changes in place: a change is a new version.

bulk.onHold_one: One chosen file is under a legal hold: Delete leaves it.
bulk.onHold_other: {count} chosen files are under a legal hold: Delete leaves them.
bulk.noneDownload: None of the chosen files can be downloaded yet.
bulk.allOffice: Every chosen file is office only already.
bulk.allHeld: A legal hold keeps every chosen file.

keep.scanPending: Held for the virus scan: it opens once the scan says it is clean.
keep.infected: The virus scan found something: it cannot be opened.
keep.legalHold: Legal hold: it cannot be deleted.

empty.title: No files yet
empty.add: Add one with Add files…, or drop it here.

order.openFailed: The file could not be opened: try again.

card.largePdf: Large PDF: open it to see it

tab.noneOpen: No file you can open on this order
tab.noneNoAsks: No files yet, and nothing is asked
tab.noneOpenNoAsks: No file you can open on this order, and nothing is asked
tab.noneLater: no files on this order yet
tab.noneOpenLater: no file you can open on this order

held.checking_one: {count} file is being checked for viruses
held.checking_other: {count} files are being checked for viruses

answer.emptyAdd: No files yet: add one, or drop it here.

info.files: Every file of this order, by where it comes from. A file you cannot open is counted once, under the head, with the reason; it is never named.
info.doors: A file made on another page (a work order, an inspection, a shipment, an invoice) is changed there: “Open on … ›”.
info.keys: Keys: ← → ↑ ↓ move between the files · x chooses one · Enter opens it.

bulk.more: More actions for the chosen files

held.fiscal: A fiscal copy is kept as it is: it is never changed or deleted.
held.fiscalName: A fiscal copy keeps its name.
held.madeVersion: Nexus makes this paper: a new version is made on the Changes tab (“Customer's agreement”).
held.madeName: Nexus makes this paper: it keeps its name.
held.madeDelete: A paper Nexus made is replaced by a new version, never removed.
held.bornPriced: A paper Nexus made with prices keeps its mark.
held.kept: Kept until {date}: it cannot be deleted before.
held.noneOwn: Only the order's own files and its lines' change who can see them here.
held.noneDelete: None of the chosen files can be deleted: a legal hold, a fiscal copy or a paper Nexus made keeps them.
held.oneFile: Drop or choose the new file first.
held.noChange: Nothing changes: choose who can see it.

who.title: Who can see {name}
who.floor: The floor sees it: that is set on the work order.
who.link: The measurement link sees it: that is set by an invite at the thread's head.
who.happens: Office only, or Office and {party}: it applies at once.
who.customerShown: {party} sees it in their portal's Documents at once. No email is sent.
who.customerGone: {party} does not see it in their portal from now on. No email is sent.
who.never: Who added it and its versions stay. Another customer never sees it.

rename.title: Rename {name}
rename.happens: Rename makes a new version with the new name: v{n} keeps “{old}”.
rename.customer: If it is shared, the customer sees the new name in their portal.
rename.never: The old name stays in the old version.

delete.title: Delete “{name}”?
delete.warn: This cannot be undone. The audit keeps who, when and why.
delete.happens: Every version of the document goes, all at once; a legal hold or a retention refuses the whole.
delete.customer: If it is shared, it leaves the customer's portal.
delete.never: The audit trace stays. Fiscal papers and papers Nexus made are never deleted.

version.title: New version of {name}
version.hint: Drop one file here, or browse.
version.happens: The new file becomes the version in force; v{n} and the earlier ones stay, read-only. Who can see it and the price mark carry over.
version.customer: If it is shared, the customer sees the new version in their portal at once.
version.never: The earlier versions keep their bytes, who added them and when.

priced.title: Mark {name} as priced?
priced.happens: From now on only people who see prices open it. It stops going to the floor: the floor sees no prices.
priced.happensOff: Everyone who reaches the order opens it again.
priced.customer: Customer people without prices stop seeing it.
priced.customerOff: If it is shared, the customer's people without prices see it again.
priced.never: Only people who see prices take the mark off.

problem.failed: That did not go through: try again.
problem.forbidden: You do not have the right to do this.
problem.notFound: This file is no longer there: the list is read again.
problem.stale: Someone changed this file meanwhile: the list is read again. Try again.

done.saved: Who can see it is saved.
done.renamed: Renamed: the new name is a new version.
done.version: The new version is in force.
